entries.title: Proverbs 9:1
segments: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars;

entries.title: Proverbs 9:2
segments: she has killed her beasts; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:3
segments: She has sent out her young women; she cries upon the highest places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:4
segments: The simple one, let him turn in here. [To one] lacking heart, she says to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:5
segments: Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:6
segments: Forsake the foolish and live; and go in the way of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:7
segments: One rebuking a scorner gets shame to himself; and one rebuking a wicked one [gets] himself a blemish.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:8
segments: Do not reprove a scorner, lest he hate you; give to a wise man, and he will love you.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:9
segments: Give to a wise one, and he will be still wiser; teach a just one, and he will increase in learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:10
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom; and the knowledge of the holy [is] understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:11
segments: For by Me your days shall be multiplied, and the years of your life shall he increased.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:12
segments: If you are wise, you shall be wise for yourself; but [if] you scorn, you alone shall bear [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 9:13
segments: A foolish woman [is] noisy; she [is] simple and knows nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:14
segments: For she sits at the door of her house, in a seat in the high places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:15
segments: to call those who pass by, who are going straight [on] their ways;

entries.title: Proverbs 9:16
segments: The simple one, let him turn in here. And to one lacking heart, she says to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:17
segments: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:18
segments: But he does not know that the dead [are] there; her guests [are] in the depths of hell.
